# Mixed Change Fixture

Synthetic fixture for `/picm-adopt` and `/picm-maintain` multi-operation review. An agreed direction may modify `AGENTS.md`, create `reference/approval-notes.md`, delete `reference/obsolete.md`, and move `routing/legacy-route.md` to `routing/current-route.md`. These effects must be explained before conversational sign-off; merely inspecting this fixture authorizes no edits.
